title: DriveDreamer-2: LLM-Enhanced World Models for Diverse Driving Video Generation

control_signal.value: free-form user text prompt, which an LLM turns into agent trajectories; an HDMap is generated from them, and 3D boxes are derived. Optionally an initial frame or front-view video.

control_mechanism.value: Fine-tuned GPT-3.5 emits Python trajectory scripts; ControlNet-based HDMap generator on SD2.1; HDMaps and projected 3D boxes concatenated with noisy latent in the video generator; UniMVM mask formulation.

base_model.value: Stable Video Diffusion (all parameters finetuned) for the video generator; SD2.1 with ControlNet for HDMap generation; GPT-3.5 for trajectories.

datasets.value: nuScenes: 700 training and 150 validation videos, six cameras, 12Hz annotations.

metrics.value: Frame-wise FID, FVD; downstream StreamPETR 3D detection (mAP, mAOE, mAVE, NDS) and tracking (AMOTA, AMOTP, IDS) with synthetic data.

controllability_evidence.value: Qualitative customized videos (cut-in, lane change, pedestrian crossing); quality FID 11.2 and FVD 55.7 with first-frame condition; detection and tracking gains from generated data. No explicit control-following metric in packet.

closed_loop.value: No; open-loop video generation of N = 8 frame clips.

notes: Control passes through an LLM, a trajectory library of 18 functions, and an HDMap generator before video. Limitations section not in packet.
